thread:
Alex (AE): quick heads-up — Prospect (Raj) just flagged two exec blockers for the PoC: legal wants indemnity + data residency clarified, and finance won't sign off unless we confirm a short-term pricing commitment. They want a decision by EOD Fri.
Maria (SE): can you paste the exact asks from Raj?
Alex (AE): Raj said: 'we need either a VPC/private deploy for the trial or a binding data residency clause; also finance wants a 3-week price lock on PoC unit rates.'
Dustin (Legal): indemnity note — customer is asking for a $5M cap and broad IP carveouts. Our standard cap is $1M for hosted; we can entertain $2M for enterprise deals if product/ops commit to mitigations. Need to confirm deployment mode.
Sophia (CRO): tagging @Maria and @Dustin — I'll join an exec bridge if we need to override standard terms. If this is Hosted-only and no egress, we can probably keep the cap at $1M with a tight scoping clause.
Maria (SE): technical reality — PoC is planned on Hosted Dedicated (reserved pool), not full Private. We can enforce region scoping (EU-only) and strict KV/prefix caching off for the trial. No model weights leave the cluster.
Dustin (Legal): ok. If Hosted Dedicated in EU and we contractually bind data residency + no model export, I can propose a redline limiting indemnity to 2x our standard (so $2M) with a negotiated exclusion for customer data breach caused by their keys/agents. Need decision from Sales/RevOps on whether pricing concessions are acceptable.
Alex (AE): Finance said: they need a temporary 3-week price lock at the quoted PoC unit rate, and a $25k credit cap for the trial. Willing to escalate to Exec if required.
Sophia (CRO): propose this path: 1) Offer EU-hosted Dedicated PoC; 2) Legal offers up to $2M cap with carveouts; 3) Sales offers 3-week price lock + $20k trial credit (instead of $25k) — that buys us margin and keeps them happy. Thoughts?
Maria (SE): technically feasible. Timeline: infra can provision a dedicated pool in EU within 48 hours once order triggers. Need SOC/infra sign-off for the provisioning checklist.
Dustin (Legal): I can draft a one-page PoC amendment tonight with the indemnity language and data residency clause. Please confirm names for countersign.
Raj (CTO - Prospect): appreciate the quick responses. Private on-prem isn't possible for us for the PoC timeline, EU hosting is acceptable. Would like the 3-week price lock and trial credit on agreement. Also we need SSO in the trial.
Alex (AE): noted, Raj — SSO is doable via SAML for the Dedicated pool. Maria — estimate SSO setup time?
Maria (SE): SAML setup + user mappings ~ 2 business days once we have metadata. If they want SCIM provisioning it adds another day.
Sophia (CRO): action items: (1) Dustin to share PoC amendment draft by tonight; (2) Maria to confirm SSO checklist and infra ETA; (3) Alex to confirm trial credit/price lock with Finance and get back in 2 hrs. I'll be on the exec bridge if needed after 4pm.
Oncall Bot: calendar invite created: "Prospect PoC Bridge — Legal/Exec Review" Thu 16:00 UTC (link: https://calendar.example/evt/12345)
Alex (AE): update in 90m — Finance okayed $20k credit + 3-week price lock conditional on signing the amendment and PO. Dustin: please lower the indemnity ask to $2M in the draft then we can route to Raj for countersign.
Dustin (Legal): will do. Draft going to the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Raj (CTO - Prospect): thanks, team. Will circulate our SAML metadata today and get back on countersign flow. :raised_hands:
